changes.reason: Harden trusted collision preflight against two non-material observer failure modes: repeated unrelated open-PR snapshot churn and an avoidable /commits/{branch} read dependency. The trusted PR path now binds its start fence to pull_request_target event base.sha, derives the end fence from the candidate current base.sha, retries only recognized rate-limit 403s, and continues to fail closed for material collisions, semantic inspection errors, base movement, candidate-head movement, permission failures, and unknown provider failures.
